buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Bid Specific ATC Clauses 1. Eligibility Criteria: 1.1 The bidder must have at least two years’ experience (ending mon th of March prior to the bid opening) of providing similar type of service s to central/ State Government/ PSUs/ Nationalized Banks/ Public Listed Company. Copies of relevant contracts/orders to be uploaded along wit h bid in support of having provided services during each of the Financia l year. 1.2 The bidder must have successfully executed/ completed similar s ervices, over the last two years i.e. ending on 31st March of the previous financial year. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited B alance Sheets of relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the completed financial years after the date of constitution/ Incorporati on of the bidder is less than 2 years old, the average turnover in respec t of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 1.2.1 Three similar completed services costing not less than Rs. 1.00 cr ore each; OR 1.2.2 Two similar completed services costing not less than Rs. 2.00 cro res each; OR 1.2.3 One similar completed service costing not less than Rs. 3.00 cror es. 1.3 Estimated bid value indicated is solely for the purpose of guidance for det ermining Eligibility criteria relating to Turn Over, past performance and project/ Past Experience etc. This has no relevance or bearing on the price quoted by th e bidders and is also not going to have any impact on bid participation. Also, thi s is not going to be used as a criteria in determining reasonableness of quoted prices which would be determined by the buyer based on its own assessment of reasonableness and based on competitive prices received in Bid/ RA process. 2. TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF THE CONTRACT: A. Additional Terms and conditions: Following additional terms and conditi ons are proposed (included in draft bid): - (i) Geographic Presence: The bidder must have the registered Head Off ice in NCR of Delhi (which includes Noida, Ghaziabad, Faridabad & Gurugram) a

nd certificate of incorporation/Registration showing the Office address (of Delhi NCR) must be attached with the Bid documents as proof. (ii) Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bi dder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. (iii) Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the origi nal certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. (iv) Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. The buyer will not take any responsibility in this regard. GST reimburse ment will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subje ct to the maximum quoted GST %. (v) Dedicated Telephone No. for Service Support: BIDDER must have Dedicated Telephone No. for Service Support. (vi) Duration of initial contract will be two years which may be extended up to six months subject to satisfactory performance and mutual consent, on annu al basis. (vii) Escalation Matrix for Service Support: Bidder must provide Escalation M atrix of Service Support executives (with Telephone Numbers). (viii) For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria: a. Purchase Order copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bid der that supplies against the invoices have been executed. b. Execution certificate by client with order value. c. Any other document in support of order execution like Third Party Inspecti on release note, etc. (ix) ISO Certification: The bidder of the offered products must have ISO 90 01 certification (in manpower). (x) OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decre ase the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of the bid quantity at the time o f placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the or dered quantity by up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of t he contract at the contracted rates. Bidders are bound to accept the orders acc ordingly. (xi) PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on t

heir own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, EPF, etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. (xii) Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fix ed Deposit Receipt (FDR) also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). The FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of TRAI A/C (Name of the S eller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on t he demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorse ment on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering lette r. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer with in 15 days of award of contract. (xiii) Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Ac count Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC) . DD should be made in favour of TRAI payable at Delhi. After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has t o ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. (xiv) SCOPE OF SERVICE (Bid price to include all cost components): Payment T erms as mentioned in the service level agreement of the service. (xv) BUYER SPECIFIC: Wages fixed by the State Government of state of consignee or Central Government, whichever is higher, will be applicable and selected bidder will ensure payment of wages and other statutory dues like EPF, ELDI etc. accordingly. (xvi) REQUIRED DOCUMENTS TO BE SUBMITTED ALONG WITH TENDER: The tenderer should enclose self-attested photocopies of the following certificates: - (a) Certificate of Incorporation (b) EPF Registration (c) ESI Registration Certificate (d) PAN Number (e) GST registration Certificate (f) ISO 9001 Certificate (g) MSME Certificate/NSIC Certificate/ Start Up, if any(valid certificate to be attached) (h) two previous Work Experience certificate such as work orders, work- co mpletion certificates by employer with Contract Value (Year 2024-25 & 2025-2 6)

(i) Turn over certificate duly certified by Chartered Accountant and Audited Annual Account for the last two years (2024-25 and 2025-26) (j) Document showing that company is having its registered Head office in NCT of Delhi (k) Escalation matrix for Service support (l) Toll free number for service support. (m) GST Return / deposit for the last financial year with GSTR-3B (Copy of la st Financial Year) (n) Undertaking for non-black listing certificate. (o) Undertaking certificate from bidder for accepting ATC. (p) Scanned copy of Authorization letter/power of attorney of person signing the tender. (q) Scanned copy of Registered Deed of partnership/Memorandum and Articl es of Association/By laws & certificate of Registration. (r) Bid Security Declaration Form (xvii) OTHER TERMS & CONDITIONS a. The agency/service provider shall immediately withdraw/replace such man power who are not found suitable by TRAI for any reasons and if such request is made. b. The agency/service provider’s personnel shall not claim any benefit/compen sation/ absorption/regularization of services under the provision of the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 or Contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act, 1970. c. The agency/service provider’s personnel shall not divulge or disclose to any person, any details of operational processes, data and administrative/organizati onal matters as most are of confidential/secret nature. d. The agency/service provider’s personnel working should be polite, cordial, p ositive and efficient, while handling the assigned work so that their actions pro mote goodwill and enhance the image of TRAI. e. The agency/service provider shall ensure proper conduct of his personnel in TRAI premises, and enforce prohibition of consumption of alcoholic drinks, paan, smoking, loitering without work. f. The agency/service provide shall be responsible for any act of indiscipline o n the part of persons deployed by it. g. No wage/remuneration will be paid to any staff for the days of absence from duty. This applies when there is no leave balance in account of the worker. h. The Agency shall provide all benefits/facilities to its deployed personnel as applicable under the Code on Social Security, 2020, and other applicable labour laws, rules and regulations, as amended from time to time.
